ExecuteLua.code: System.LogAlways('[MercHorse_' .. tostring(entity:GetName()) .. '] BT START: mercenary_follow initializing.')

data.isCampSitter = false data.isCampSleeper = false local f = mercenaries:GetCampFurniture(entity.this.id) if f and f.wuid and f.pos then data.campFurniture = f.wuid data.campFurniturePos.x = f.pos.x data.campFurniturePos.y = f.pos.y data.campFurniturePos.z = f.pos.z if f.kind == 'bed' then data.isCampSleeper = true else data.isCampSitter = true end end

data.chatRole = 0 local c = _G.MercCampChat if c then local myW = tostring(entity.this.id) if tostring(c.a) == myW then data.chatRole = 1; data.chatPartner = c.b elseif tostring(c.b) == myW then data.chatRole = 2; data.chatPartner = c.a end end

data.campActMode = 0 data.campActDrawWeapon = false data.campActHasFace = false local a = mercenaries:GetCampActivity(entity.this.id) if a and a.pos then if a.unstance then data.campActUnstance = a.unstance end data.campActPos.x = a.pos.x data.campActPos.y = a.pos.y data.campActPos.z = a.pos.z if a.locWuid then data.campActLoc = a.locWuid end if a.slaveWuid then data.campActSlave = a.slaveWuid end if a.facePos then data.campActFace.x = a.facePos.x data.campActFace.y = a.facePos.y data.campActFace.z = a.facePos.z data.campActHasFace = true end data.campActDrawWeapon = (a.drawWeapon == true) data.campActMode = a.mode or 2 end

local ok, err = pcall(function() local horseName = 'MercenaryHorse_' .. tostring(entity:GetName()) local existingHorse = System.GetEntityByName(horseName)
if data.playerIsMounted then if existingHorse then data.horse = existingHorse.this.id data.horseSpawned = true return end if data.mountAbandoned then return end
local pos = entity:GetPos() if not pos then return end
local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi local offset = 5.0

for i = 1, #mercId do hash = (hash * 31 + string.byte(mercId, i)) % 100003 end
local horseNumber = (hash % 7) + 1
System.LogAlways('[Merc horse assignment] ' .. tostring(mercId) .. ' ' .. tostring(horseNumber) .. ' ' .. tostring(hash))

'] spawned fresh horse, exists=' .. tostring(horseEnt ~= nil)) else data.horseSpawned = false data.mountAbandoned = false if existingHorse then data.despawnCountdown = (data.despawnCountdown or 3) - 1 if data.despawnCountdown < 1 then System.RemoveEntity(existingHorse.id) data.despawnCountdown = 3 end else data.despawnCountdown = 3 end end end) if not ok then System.LogAlways('[MercHorse_' .. tostring(entity:GetName()) .. '] horse lifecycle error: ' .. tostring(err)) end

data.patrolHasWaypoint = false pcall(function() local wp = mercenaries:GetPatrolWaypoint(entity.this.id) if wp then data.patrolWaypoint.x = wp.x data.patrolWaypoint.y = wp.y data.patrolWaypoint.z = wp.z data.patrolHasWaypoint = true end end)
